rationale: Deterministic evidence confirms exact changed and already-completed ID sets, duplicate rejection, byte-identical unknown-ID failure, idempotence, banner placement, and all art constraints. The implementation validates syntax and duplicates before storage access, verifies every requested ID before mutation, preserves request order in summaries, and writes once after all validation. HashSet and dictionary use make the intent clear and robust; a minor inefficiency is rewriting storage on a fully idempotent call even when no task changes. Help and focused tests cover JSON cleanliness, text output, malformed and missing IDs, atomic failures, and repeated calls. The banner is a strong, immediately recognizable BULK mode panel with a large letterform, clear completion subtitle, balanced framing, and excellent spacing within the fixed dimensions. The diff is focused and clean.
